fixedDuringAudit.issue: The new local tool name and source-binding argument could collide with external tool contracts.
fixedDuringAudit.fix: Reserve write_prepare in read/write descriptor admission and reject an external _source_binding_id argument.
fixedDuringAudit.verification: Existing descriptor tests extended for both collisions; paid scenarios evaluated this fix.

fixedDuringAudit.issue: After an interrupted DRAFT resumed and committed in the original turn, the model-facing tool result still reported ok=false and status=draft.
fixedDuringAudit.fix: Return the current journal state after finalization rather than the pre-finalization snapshot.
fixedDuringAudit.verification: Fault injection reproduced before the change. A unit regression now checks one successful dispatch, original operation identity, and a succeeded result. This fix was made after the paid run; verified without another model call.

openFindings.evidence: A real Podman repository diagnostic completes a linked task and cancels the same reminder using versions read before the batch. Task-first raises PERSONAL_VERSION_CONFLICT and atomically rolls both changes back. Reminder-first and task-only both finish with task done and reminder cancelled.
openFindings.cause: A task completion implicitly cancels and versions linked reminders, but later operations in the same atomic batch validate against that changed version instead of the batch input state.
openFindings.paidCoverage: The paid task scenario passed with an unlinked task and reminder (taskId null), so it does not refute this failure.
openFindings.nextStep: Define batch-level preconditions and reconcile overlapping effects under the same transaction, preserving genuine stale-version detection and final-state receipts. Do not depend on model operation ordering.

openFindings.evidence: A free service-level fault injection stops before durable approval. The original turn can resume its DRAFT, but a new user retry with the remembered binding returns WRITE_SOURCE_BINDING_UNAVAILABLE with no remote dispatch.
openFindings.cause: The binding remembers an operation ID at DRAFT creation, while only the original proposal run may approve that DRAFT. Later bindings cannot replace an entry with operationId. There is no safe transition transferring or abandoning the never-approved draft for a new retry.
openFindings.limits: Diagnostic uses the real BusinessWriteService and fake journal/writer; not a forced production process crash.
openFindings.nextStep: Define and test a fenced transactional recovery transition for never-approved drafts, keeping approval checks and the approved/unknown operation identity guarantees intact.
